name: Manastorm Sunken Temple Eranikus: the Chaotic Link adds can be found and killed (#12142)
contract: #12142: in the Manastorm Shade of Eranikus stage (segment 677) the boss carries Chaotic Link (93459) with two
stacks, and killing the stage's link adds removes them. The link adds of 677 and 680 are Morphaz (5719, spawn
33657) and Hazzas (5722, spawn 33658). instance_sunken_temple hides the four Sanctum dragons (invisible,
passive, not selectable and immune to players) until the Avatar of Hakkar 8443 and Jammal'an 5710 die; the
Eranikus stage skips both kills, so the adds stayed hidden and Chaotic Link could never fade. The stage now
starts with the Sanctum dragons released, as after those two kills. The player is not a game master (GM mode
is turned off), who would see hidden creatures; nearby_creature_at_client reports whether the dragon reached the
player's client and nearby_creature_can_attack uses Player::IsValidAttackTarget. Morphaz stands still and Hazzas
walks x -653 from y 7 to y 134, so his presence control waits for him to come within range. Eranikus is checked
from about 50 yards so he is not pulled: while he is in combat the stage makes dragonkin evade. The aura metric
counts living Eranikus with the aura, so it reads 0 only after both stacks are consumed.

steps.label: The player entered a private Manastorm instance
CONTROL: the stage is in Sunken Temple
The player sees only what a player sees
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room
The player moves about 50 yards from Shade of Eranikus
Leaving the preparation bubble clears its safety aura
CONTROL: Shade of Eranikus carries Chaotic Link
The player moves to Morphaz
CONTROL: Morphaz's spawn is loaded beside the player
Morphaz reaches the player's client
Morphaz can be attacked
The player kills Morphaz
CONTROL: Hazzas' patrol comes within range of the player
Hazzas reaches the player's client
Hazzas can be attacked
The player moves to Hazzas
The player kills Hazzas
The player returns to about 50 yards from Shade of Eranikus
CONTROL: Shade of Eranikus is still alive within range
Killing both link adds removed Chaotic Link from Shade of Eranikus
